name: Juliette
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, she features a cool brown shadow root that blends into sandy beige blonde through the mid-lengths. Fine ash-blonde and taupe ribbons add subtle depth, while lighter, creamy blonde pieces brighten the hairline and frame the face. The color gradually softens into pale cream blonde toward the tips.

All photos are taken in natural lighting. She arrives professionally colored and styled. Care for her as you would your natural hair and touch her up after unboxing if needed.

All sales are final.
